additional_environment.sizing: 4096-shot pilots at workers=1 and 64; choose a power of two from 4096 to 1048576 so extrapolated slower sampling time is at most 40 seconds. Same count for all workers and repeats of each task.

ideal_state.method: native joint contraction with inverse-preparation target boundary

result.normalization: mean joint contributions; conditional error is ratio of aggregate means
result.uncertainty: IID draw standard errors; conditional ratio uses paired delta method; null for fewer than two draws

weights.convention: original-noise likelihood ratio times complete history mass / history proposal probability
weights.ess_scope: complete importance weights; not a guarantee of target-fidelity precision

efficiency.comparison: same noise proposal and terminal estimator; exact_marginal draws histories from their true conditionals
